esql: from logs-aws.cloudtrail-* metadata _id, _index, _version | where to_lower(event.provider) == "bedrock.amazonaws.com" and (to_lower(event.action) in ("putusecaseformodelaccess", "createfoundationmodelagreement") or to_lower(event.action) == "putfoundationmodelentitlement") and not starts_with(to_lower(aws.cloudtrail.user_identity.arn), "arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/allowlisted-ai-platform-admin/")
golang_expr: lower(eventSource) == lower("bedrock.amazonaws.com") and (lower(eventName) == lower("PutUseCaseForModelAccess") or lower(eventName) == lower("CreateFoundationModelAgreement") or lower(eventName) == lower("PutFoundationModelEntitlement")) and not (lower(userIdentity?.arn) startsWith lower("arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/allowlisted-ai-platform-admin/"))
sqlite: SELECT * FROM <TABLE_NAME> WHERE (eventSource='bedrock.amazonaws.com' AND ((eventName='PutUseCaseForModelAccess' OR eventName='CreateFoundationModelAgreement') OR eventName='PutFoundationModelEntitlement')) AND (NOT `userIdentity.arn` LIKE 'arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/allowlisted-ai-platform-admin/%' ESCAPE '\')
